correction.details: The rejection review attributed the `not raw` check at candidate line 129 to `read()`. In the exact pinned candidate, line 129 belongs to `json_object()`. The `read()` function starts at line 144 and accepts a zero-byte regular file: its lstat size check permits size zero, the read loop returns b'', the length check accepts 0 == st_size, stable fstat identity is checked, and b'' is returned. The two stderr call sites use read(), so V7 can read the expected empty launch/status stderr files. The V7 review's only blocker is therefore based on a source-location misread and must not be used to reject V7.
correction.scope: This note corrects the independent review classification only. It does not change, rerun, or re-review V7 source, proof, caller, helper, reader, driver, receipts, or any result.
